 "explanation": "The unit responds to circular, round-framed objects seen roughly face-on, especially dials and gauges with a rim (pocket gauges, speedometers, watches, stopwatches, barometers, washing-machine doors). It responds more weakly to other circular rimmed shapes such as cups, bowls, buckets, bottle caps, discs, lenses and round plaques.",
 "evidence": "The top activations are dominated by circular dials and gauges (#1, #3, #5, #11–13, #20) and porthole-like washer doors (#2, #4). The lower-ranked images are other round rimmed objects (mug #10, coffee cup #17, bucket #15, bowl #19, caps #14, CDs/records #9, lens #16, blue plaque #8, round speaker #18).",
 "missing_data": "Activations on non-round dials such as rectangular gauges or digital displays, and on plain circles without any dial markings, would show whether the unit is tuned to dials specifically or to circular rims in general.",
 "confidence": 0.75}
